text: AB Electrolux's largest shareholder is Investor AB, which held 17.94 percent of the shares and 30.43 percent of the votes in May 2026.

source.name: Nasdaq – AB Electrolux notice: 'Electrolux Group announces terms for the fully underwritten rights issue of SEK 9,062 million'
source.quote: Investor AB, holding 17.94 percent of the shares and 30.43 percent of the votes in AB Electrolux
source.note: Exchange notice by AB Electrolux about a rights issue of Class A and B shares; it also names Frigidaire among the group's brands ('including Electrolux, AEG and Frigidaire').
